مُرْمِدٌ A she-camel, (Ks, T, TA,) and a cow, and a ewe, or she-goat, (TA,) secreting milk in her udder a little before her bringing forth; (Ks, T, TA;) as also مُرِدٌّ: (Ks, T:) or both signify a she-camel having her udder shining, and infused with milk. (Ks, L in art. رد.) [See also مُرَمِّدٌ, in the second paragraph of this art.] ―
-b2- See also رَمِدٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
